text_block_list.text:
Hearing that a new ocean zone was added to 
the VR world, I came to check it out—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Well met, little lamb. Drawn by the 
majestic open waters as well, I take it?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Then why not try some fishing? It's a 
rewarding way to commune with nature!

Having no urgent matters to attend to, I 
decided to give it a shot.
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and relax.

text_block_list.text:
I cast my line right away, but the fish 
underwater didn't pay it any attention...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, struggling, are we? Nature is 
formidable; it won't yield easily!

...I moved spots, jerked the rod left and 
right, and swapped bait, but the result 
remained unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, not even a single nibble. At this 
rate, you might end up empty-handed...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is merely recreation. Whether 
to press on or withdraw is entirely up to 
you, little lamb.
choice_data_list:
...I'm not giving up until I catch 
something!

text_block_list.text:
It may only be simulated sweltering heat, 
but the scorching sensation feels real... 
Still, I won't give in!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Movement on the rod! Reel it up all at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Haha, beautiful fish! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Result of facing it seriously, not 
treating it as just virtual world or just 
game!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Be proud. Your tenacity overcame nature!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Greedy hunger is your individuality, 
Little Lamb. Mighty sea was perfect to 
nurture that.

Greedy hunger as individuality. Not just 
for fishing, useful for daily training 
too. ...Hadn't realized that myself.
choice_data_list: Fished just to teach me that...?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, line's pulling again! Come on, no 
looking away!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, big catch. For now, let's just give 
thanks to majestic nature's bounty...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That's best part of fishing too! Now, 
let's wait patiently.

Pleasant breeze and sunshine. Almost makes 
one forget this is virtual world...

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Sound of timeless, repeating waves... 
Feels like soul being cleansed.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Still, fishing means catching fish. How 
about changing spots?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
I see... That's freedom too. I'll stick 
with you all way!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh?! Little Lamb, bite! You've got 
bite!

What got reeled in was huge fish. Patient 
wait paid off.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, amazing. Maybe master of sea opened 
up to your serene patience.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Nature is honest. Sees through hearts, 
sometimes toys with us.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Be proud. You harmonized with nature. 
Through your own unique individuality.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, maybe no need for me to test you 
like that after all.

Come to think of it, Darley Arabian 
suggested changing spots earlier. Testing 
qualities as trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Zzz...

She had started napping before knowing it, 
leaving true intent unanswered.
